verdict.rationale: Trello documents its own public REST API, with API keys and delegated user-token auth (1/authorize and OAuth1.0), configurable scopes, and Batch, Search and Webhooks resources. It also lists an MCP server for connecting AI tools. The pack shows a substantial programmatic surface, but nothing establishes that everything doable in the UI can also be done through the API. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or a full resource reference, endpoint-level coverage of UI features (Power-Ups like card mirroring and merging, covers, list colors, Inbox, calendar), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
